title: Air-quality monitoring
prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting excessive industrial emissions in an air-quality report

1. Start with the monitoring records.
2.
source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting excessive industrial emissions in an air-quality report

1. Start with the monitoring records.
2.
completion:
Obtain permission to access the necessary data.
3. Record all relevant dates, times, and locations.
4. Use certified measuring instruments to take samples.
5. Ensure all equipment is properly calibrated and validated.
6. Document the type and concentration of pollutants.
7. Record meteorological data, including wind speed, direction, and other factors.
8. Take photographs or videos if possible, noting the exact time and location.
9. Interview plant personnel about the emissions and their documentation.
10. Cross-reference your findings with any mandatory reporting data by the company.
11. Conduct comparisons with permitted emission levels.
12. Identify any visible signs of negligence or violations.
13. Compile all data and supporting material into a detailed report.
14. Verify the accuracy of your report with a peer review process, if possible.
15. Include recommendations on corrective measures, if warranted, based on your findings.
16. Include any legal implications or potential violations in the report.
17.
